svg.title: A conspiratorial wink
svg.desc: A unilateral eyelid squeeze, one raised eyebrow and one tight mouth corner make an asymmetric expression. Seven-second native SVG loop. 0–1 s: readable resting expression; 1–2 s: small anticipation; 2–3.4 s: One brow lifts, the opposite eye winks, then one mouth corner curls with a delayed cheek response. 3.4–4.8 s: sustain the emotional peak; 4.8–6 s: secondary features ease back; 6–7 s: exact return to the initial pose. The coordinated blink closes at 2.17 s and reopens at 2.45 s.
